title: Page 2
summary: The text is a heavily garbled OCR scan, mostly unreadable. Legible fragments describe a discovery of a three-celled structure about 30 feet in diameter, with humanoid figures only about 3 feet tall, encased in metallic cloth. One chamber held three bodies wrapped in fine bandage-like material. Other fragments mention a government, investigators, and saucer-shaped objects. Much of the content cannot be recovered.
